releaseNotes:
• Continuous Watertight 3D Floor Geometry: Seamless, unbroken interior floor slab at Z = 0 under all rooms and partition walls with zero face tearing or missing triangles
• Synchronized Elevation Facades: 2D elevation imports strictly project actual plan walls and openings without artificial plinths, slabs, or parapets
• Dark Charcoal Elevation Import UI: High-contrast dropdown menu with custom dark theme, cyan/emerald action highlights, and crisp readable typography
• Interactive 2D-to-3D View Communication: Direct facade selection badges in 2D floor plan, dynamic 3D camera orbit drag handle, and bidirectional object cross-selection
